runners_data.name: Due To Shine
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 193-day absence, needs significant improvement from last autumn's nursery form
runners_data.comment: In the frame in two nurseries but beaten over 6l on each occasion; improvement necessary
runners_data.spotlight: Finished in the money in her two nursery runs last autumn but she was beaten over 6l on each occasion; improvement necessary to win.

races.paceDynamic: Sovereign Bright and Meritocratic will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to go hard from the start over this 1m2f trip. Pantile's Gift sits prominent behind them while the remaining four runners (Raven's View, Fuzeyya, Project Kinsman, Due To Shine) are all hold-up types who will be well back early. With only two genuine pace-setters in a small field, the early gallop may not be truly testing, allowing the leaders to dictate. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems and capitalize on a potentially moderate early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Dominate Small Field
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between Sovereign Bright and Meritocratic proves moderate rather than punishing
scenarios.body: The two front-runners can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back, with Pantile's Gift best placed to pick up the pieces if either fades. The hold-up horses face a tactical nightmare with limited pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners go too conservatively and create a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the 2f pole where the fresher hold-up horses can unleash their turns of foot. Raven's View and Fuzeyya benefit most from the step up in trip under these conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Honest Gallop Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Sovereign Bright and Meritocratic engage in a genuine battle that creates a true test
scenarios.body: Pantile's Gift gets the perfect setup sitting behind two committed leaders, inheriting their pace work while staying out of trouble. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go extremely slowly and create a tactical mess
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery with positioning crucial in the final 2f. Any horse can win but those with tactical speed have the edge in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch for a pedestrian early pace if Sovereign Bright and Meritocratic refuse to engage, creating a tactical mess
Monitor Meritocratic's fitness after 112 days off as any weakness could leave Sovereign Bright with an uncontested lead
Observe Pantile's Gift's position turning for home as Hollie Doyle may need to commit earlier than ideal with limited pace up front
Check if any of the hold-up horses get badly positioned early as they'll struggle to make up ground in a slowly-run race
Watch Raven's View's stamina at this new trip as the step up from 7f to 1m2f represents a significant test

races.paceDynamic: Fille Unique will make the running from her prominent position with Northern Tempest, Taaklam, Stromness, Anorah Unleashed, Full Gas and Cosmic Clarets all likely to race handy in the opening stages. This creates a genuine pace scenario over 6f with multiple horses wanting to be forward, particularly dangerous given the sharp Newcastle track configuration. The large field of 14 and multiple pace angles will create a fast gallop that should set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to finish strongly. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up merchants like Marra Donna, Thornaby Annie, Mademoiselle Belle, Carnation Queen, Forever Twenty and Pivotal Terms who can sit off the pace and unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too fast early and multiple pace angles clash
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will find out the leaders in the final furlong as they tie up, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past with superior finishing kicks. Hold-up runners with tactical speed like Marra Donna and Mademoiselle Belle are perfectly positioned to capitalize on this likely outcome.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Fille Unique manages to dictate reasonable fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with the leader able to kick clear, though prominent runners like Northern Tempest and Anorah Unleashed can still challenge if the pace doesn't collapse completely. This moderate tempo scenario gives versatile prominent runners their best chance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If an unconsidered hold-up horse produces an explosive late run from the back
scenarios.body: The strong early pace sets up a finish where a horse given time and space can produce a devastating late charge from seemingly impossible positions. Pivotal Terms or Forever Twenty could benefit from this scenario despite their recent struggles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Fille Unique gets soft early splits and kicks clear of tiring challengers
scenarios.body: The leader manages to control the race tactically and has enough in reserve to hold off late challenges, with the pace angle working in her favor rather than against. This requires everything to fall perfectly for the front end.

watchPoints.text: Fille Unique could steal this if she gets uncontested lead and the pace pressure doesn't materialize early
Multiple prominent runners Northern Tempest, Anorah Unleashed and Taaklam could create pace chaos if they all go forward together
Marra Donna has the perfect hold-up style for this race shape but needs the strong pace scenario to develop
Mademoiselle Belle wearing cheekpieces could produce another bold effort from off the pace like her recent win
Market support for Pivotal Terms would suggest stable confidence after her recent Tapeta struggles

races.paceDynamic: Wicket Keeper will likely lead from his prominent style, with Paddy's Day and Evening Saigon tracking close behind in the early pace. At 6f on the all-weather, this moderate pace should hold together without collapse, creating an even tempo throughout. The substantial hold-up contingent of Toyotomi, Albasheer, Strike Red, The Caltonian, Grant Wood and Cajetan will need the pace to be genuine to get competitive. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can position handy and kick, as they avoid the traffic issues that will plague the large hold-up group.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Wicket Keeper sets a moderate pace that holds together
scenarios.body: The handy horses can travel smoothly and have first run on the field, while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic behind a wall of runners. Paddy's Day and Evening Saigon are perfectly positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and the race opens up
scenarios.body: The prominent horses tie up after pressing too hard, allowing the closers clear runs to mount their challenges effectively. Grant Wood and The Caltonian can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wicket Keeper Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Wicket Keeper gets soft fractions and finds another gear
scenarios.body: The leader proves too strong when asked for effort, maintaining his advantage as the field comes to him but cannot get past. His recent fourth showing improved form supports this outcome.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and kicks late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole, suiting a horse with tactical speed who can quicken sharply. Toyotomi's hold-up style and gelding operation could unlock improvement.

watchPoints.text: Wicket Keeper could steal this if getting uncontested lead and soft fractions from his natural front-running position
Traffic problems likely in straight with six hold-up runners needing room simultaneously behind moderate early pace
Paddy's Day stretching to 6f with tongue tie suggests connections expecting more, but distance remains question mark
Evening Saigon and Grant Wood both returning from breaks but showing better recent form than most rivals
The Caltonian's blinkers and hold-up style needs genuine pace to be competitive against this field

races.paceDynamic: Showcasing Star is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gates, setting what should be a sustainable gallop without early pressure. Eddaari and Sovereign Bay are the prominent runners who will track just behind, while the majority including Far Far Out, Heathers Feather, Master Of Entropy, Too Darn Spicy and Alembic are hold-up types who need the race to develop. With minimal early pace pressure, Showcasing Star can control fractions and the race may not open up sufficiently for the closers until too late. This race shape clearly favours the pace-setters and prominent racers who can secure good tactical positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Showcasing Star Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Showcasing Star gets an easy lead and dictates moderate fractions.
scenarios.body: The lone leader faces minimal early pressure and can quicken when it matters, making life difficult for the hold-up brigade who need a strong pace to be effective. This tactical advantage could overcome his form deficiency and deliver the improvement his connections seek.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Eddaari and Sovereign Bay track the leader perfectly and pounce late.
scenarios.body: Both prominent runners get ideal trips behind the uncontested leader and can use their superior form figures when the race opens up in the final two furlongs. Eddaari's class edge from his turf runs gives him the final say over the consistent but limited Sovereign Bay.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Far Far Out or Heathers Feather show significant improvement from their debuts.
scenarios.body: The Varian or Waggott newcomer produces the step forward that lightly-raced types often show, overcoming the tactical disadvantage through sheer ability. Their inexperience at judging pace could prove costly but raw talent might prevail if the fractions collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horror Show
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is too slow and the closers get caught flat-footed.
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed creates a sprint finish that doesn't suit any of the hold-up horses, leaving them with too much ground to make up. Master Of Entropy, Too Darn Spicy and Alembic all struggle to land a blow despite their jockeys' best efforts to find racing room.

watchPoints.text: Showcasing Star getting an uncontested lead could prove decisive if he can dictate comfortable fractions throughout.
Far Far Out or Heathers Feather showing early pace keenness would completely alter the tactical complexion and help the hold-up horses.
Eddaari's fitness after 137 days off - any signs of rustiness early could hand tactical advantage to lesser rivals.
The market move on any of the hold-up debutants would suggest significant home work and potential for upset.
Sovereign Bay's hood application suggesting connections expect improvement from this consistent but limited performer.

races.paceDynamic: The Cookstown Cafu is the only confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable pace without pressure from the early stages. Sassy Glory and Falaise Blanc may track prominently but neither has the pace to challenge for the lead early. The lack of pace pressure means The Cookstown Cafu can dictate terms through steady fractions before the large pack of hold-up horses try to make their moves in the final two furlongs. This moderate gallop strongly favors prominent runners who can stay close to the pace and hold-up horses with a strong finishing kick, while making it difficult for anything settling too far back to make up the ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If The Cookstown Cafu maintains control without serious pace pressure through halfway
scenarios.body: The steady tempo allows the leader to stay strong late while prominent trackers get first run on the field. Hold-up horses settling too far back struggle to make up enough ground in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The lack of early tempo turns this into a sprint finish where horses with the strongest turn of foot can unleash from off the pace. Class horses with finishing speed benefit most from the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Builds
scenarios.trigger: If Sassy Glory or Falaise Blanc apply more pace pressure than expected
scenarios.body: Increased tempo weakens the front runners and creates opportunities for horses tracking in fourth or fifth position. The increased gallop suits horses that can sit handy without being on the lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all the early runners go extremely slowly through the first half mile
scenarios.body: The race becomes a desperate scramble from the back where only horses with explosive finishing speed can win. Raw pace from the rear becomes essential rather than positional advantage.

watchPoints.text: The Cookstown Cafu's 105-day layoff could see him stop quickly if the pace quickens in the final quarter mile
Rocket Rod is making only his second start back after nearly two years off and may need the run badly
Barleybrown's hold-up style needs sufficient pace on to be effective so watch how fast the early fractions develop
Teggy Lasso's additional tongue tie suggests trainer concerns about his breathing or settling
Book Of Life has been runner-up three times recently so watch if he can finally convert place form into a win

races.paceDynamic: Hover On The Wind will likely dictate from the front with Darlo Pride, Herakles, Ganesha, Blue Force and Zuffolo all capable of tracking closely in this sprint. The pace should be honest but not frantic given the single confirmed leader, allowing the field to stay bunched into the final furlong. Over this stiff 5f at Newcastle, horses need to be positioned handy to have any chance, as hold-up runners like Dc Cogent, Rock Of England, Brian The Snail and Bonito Cavalo will struggle to make up ground from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can travel well and have a turn of foot.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady and Hover On The Wind sets sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 2f out where horses with tactical speed can pounce, suiting those who raced prominently but kept something in reserve. Blue Force and Herakles are perfectly positioned to exploit their C&D experience.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Hover On The Wind gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader's class tells under these conditions, while any prominent runners who went too early get swamped by the pace. His December C&D win shows he can handle these tactics when getting his own way up front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is stronger than expected and the leaders come back
scenarios.body: The race falls apart in the final furlong, allowing Dc Cogent or Rock Of England to use their finishing kicks. However, this requires a collapse up front which seems unlikely given the lack of pace pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Shot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the form horses fail to handle the return to this track or distance
scenarios.body: An outsider like Zuffolo returning from his break or Bonito Cavalo exploiting his reduced mark can capitalise on favourite failure. This requires multiple things to go wrong for the principals.

Zuffolo's early position critical as his front-running style from the long break could disrupt the pace scenario
Darlo Pride needs to overcome 34-day break but his consistent standard going form makes him a reliable each-way option
